name: @ypd/shared
description: Shared REST DTOs + WebSocket message types between the YPD backend and frontend.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))"
